title: Files, declared routes, cache headers and API keys cross the gateways
why: Downloads over 20 MiB and uploads over 64 KiB failed, webhooks could not arrive through the public origin, validators were dropped and valid keys got 403. B0750 warns about a route the gateway will not proxy.
changelog: Routes declared in `server/routes` are now reachable
API keys now cross the gateways
